definitions.explanation: Studying by oneself without direct instruction from a teacher.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{休|やす}みなので{自習|じしゅう}だ。
examples.english: It's self-study because the teacher is absent.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}で{自習|じしゅう}している。
examples.english: I'm studying on my own at the library.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}は{自習|じしゅう}{時間|じかん}を{設|もう}けている。
examples.english: We have self-study time after school.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{自習|じしゅう}する (to self-study)
・{自習|じしゅう}{時間|じかん} (self-study period)
・{自習|じしゅう}{室|しつ} (study room)

SCHOOL CONTEXT:
In Japanese schools, when a teacher is absent, students often have {自習|じしゅう} - a supervised period where they study on their own.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{独学|どくがく} - self-teaching (learning something entirely on your own)
・{予習|よしゅう} - preparation (studying before class)
・{復習|ふくしゅう} - review (studying after class)
